threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the office computers and the synced shared drive, then spreads over the flat network to the test PC and oven HMI, stopping shipments of storm-stock transformers in hurricane season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; antivirus only (no EDR) with business-hours alerts; one flat Wi-Fi network for office, shop equipment, and visitors; unsupported test PC; backups never restore-tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-05; SYS-06; BP-04; BP-05
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-025, G-034); C-CRITICAL-MFG-R01 (proposed 226.5; readiness only)
existing_controls: Suite MFA; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Separate networks for office, shop equipment, and guests; MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting; training and quarterly phishing simulations; restore tests; P08 runbook and tabletop

threat_event: The test PC fails or is encrypted and cannot be rebuilt quickly; 6 years of test history is lost and no test reports can be produced, so no unit ships
threat_source: Hardware failure or malware on an unsupported computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past vendor support; no backup of the local test database; vendor media and license key not located; shared administrator login
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-023, G-024)
existing_controls: Finished test reports copied by hand to the shared drive; test set calibrated yearly
treatment_plan: Nightly copy of the test database to the shared drive; locate media and license; ask the test set vendor for a supported operating system or replacement PC with a quote by 2026-10-31; paper test forms in the downtime kit

threat_event: An attacker or an unauthorized person at the OEM uses the always-on cellular modem to change drying oven temperature or vacuum settings, damaging core and coil insulation or causing an overheating event
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider at the OEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Modem always on; the shop does not hold or rotate the credentials; no session approval or record; recipes not backed up
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-018, G-028)
existing_controls: Oven over-temperature trip and pressure relief are hard-wired and independent of the PLC (OEM manual); operator present during cycles
treatment_plan: Power the modem off except during a requested session; OEM changes credentials and sends a session record for each visit; copy recipes and the HMI project; Shop Manager approves every remote session

threat_event: A business email compromise sends a fake change of bank details from a copper wire supplier and the shop pays the fraudster
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training; bank detail changes handled by email; the call-back habit is not written down
existing_controls: Suite MFA; the Office Manager calls suppliers back before changing bank details (stopped one attempt in 2026-03)
treatment_plan: Write the call-back rule into POL-02 Part C; training with a payment fraud module; bank's payee confirmation service

threat_event: A former employee's still-active ERP or suite account is used to view pricing, customer data, or FCI
threat_source: Former employee or anyone holding the credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No leaver checklist; accounts disabled when remembered; shared shop and test PC passwords never changed
existing_controls: Keys and badges collected on the last day; the former technician's accounts disabled 2026-07-15 with no use found
treatment_plan: Leaver checklist covering ERP, suite, test PC, shared passwords, and cooperative badges; monthly account reconciliation against the staff list

threat_event: The shop misses a cooperative exhibit deadline (1-business-day access notice or 72-hour incident notice) and the cooperative suspends it as a substation vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exhibit duties not tracked or assigned; already missed once (notice for the 2026-05 departure sent 2026-07-16)
regulatory_driver: Co-op exhibit secs. 1-3 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.1-R1.2.3 flow-down; P03 G-057 to G-059)
existing_controls: None before 2026-07
treatment_plan: Obligations list with owners; cooperative notice step in the leaver checklist; 72-hour notice template in the P08 binder; written apology and corrective plan sent to the cooperative 2026-07-20

threat_event: The camera recorder turns out to be covered video surveillance equipment, and the agency withholds or ends the purchase order under FAR 52.204-25(b)(2)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recorder bought online in 2022; manufacturer not identifiable; no purchasing check for covered equipment
existing_controls: Recorder disconnected from the network on 2026-07-17
treatment_plan: Replace the kit with one whose manufacturer is documented by 2026-10-31; add a covered-equipment check to purchasing; report within 1 business day if the old kit is identified as covered

threat_event: FCI (agency site drawings and unit records) is exposed through an anyone-with-the-link share or a public AI tool
threat_source: Careless sharing; outsider who finds a link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI not identified; open sharing links allowed; no AI tool rule
existing_controls: Suite MFA
treatment_plan: Label and restrict the federal order folder; turn off anyone-with-the-link sharing; approved AI tools list (POL-04 4.7)

threat_event: An attacker who compromises the MSP's RMM platform pushes ransomware to every managed computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM has administrator rights on all 6 managed computers; no contract security terms; no evidence of MFA on the RMM; no incident notice term
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-009, G-028)
existing_controls: MSP answered a security questionnaire in 2025
treatment_plan: MSP contract amendment: MFA on the RMM and all MSP logins, 24-hour incident notice, technician list, recovery time; annual MSP review

threat_event: An attacker with a phished ERP password changes customer or supplier records, views pricing, or deletes jobs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP MFA available but not enforced; administrators use admin accounts daily; 8-character password minimum
existing_controls: ERP account lockout; vendor audit trail
treatment_plan: Enforce ERP MFA for all users; separate administrator accounts; 12-character passwords

threat_event: The shop loses its ERP data (account deleted by an attacker, vendor failure, or billing dispute) and has no copy of jobs, inventory, or receivables
threat_source: Attacker with admin access; vendor failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No shop-held export; ERP administrators without MFA
existing_controls: Vendor backups (SOC 2 report: RPO 1 hour)
treatment_plan: Enable the vendor's scheduled full export to the shared drive (kept a year by the suite backup); test a restore of the export into a spreadsheet

threat_event: A hurricane closes the shop for several days during peak storm demand (power loss, yard flooding, staff unable to travel)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No generator; one internet line; yard near grade
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-026, G-035)
existing_controls: Units on raised racks; storm stock tested and tagged before the season
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan (shutdown, backups checked, laptops taken home, contact list); portable generator for the office and test bay by 2027-05-31

threat_event: The internet line fails and the shop cannot reach the ERP or email for a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One business cable line; no failover
existing_controls: Phone hotspots
treatment_plan: Cellular failover router

threat_event: The oven PLC or winding machine controller fails and its recipes or programs cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipes only in the PLC; winding programs on USB sticks only
existing_controls: Partial copies of winding programs in the shared drive
treatment_plan: OEM exports the PLC program, recipes, and HMI project at the next service visit; Lead Winder copies all programs to the shared drive; copies checked after each change

threat_event: A departing employee copies the rewind data sheet library to a personal drive or account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Library open to every account; no USB or download controls; no exit reminder of confidentiality
existing_controls: Employees sign a confidentiality clause at hire
treatment_plan: Limit the library to the Lead Winder, Shop Manager, and Owner, with a read-only group for technicians; suite download alerts; confidentiality reminder in the leaver checklist

threat_event: A visitor's infected phone or a curious driver on the shop Wi-Fi reaches the test PC, oven HMI web page, or camera recorder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Wi-Fi password posted and shared with drivers; no guest network; HMI status page without a login
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Guest Wi-Fi with internet only; new staff password; shop equipment network with no Wi-Fi access (POAM-003)

threat_event: AI-001 under-rates a deteriorating customer transformer, the shop advises the customer it can stay in service, and it fails in service (outage, fire, or oil spill)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot without validation; vendor model not tested on this shop's customer fleet; no documented technician review step
existing_controls: The Field Service and Test Technician reads the raw DGA values before advising customers (informal)
treatment_plan: Written technician review against raw gas values for every recommendation; monthly back-check; the score is never the only basis for a keep-in-service recommendation (P10)

threat_event: Cooperative substation and equipment data uploaded to the AI vendor is used to train the vendor's models, breaching the cooperative's confidentiality clause
threat_source: Vendor data use under standard terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started under standard terms that allow model training; no customer consent
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Data processing addendum barring training use; remove site coordinates from uploads; written consent from the 3 customers whose data is in the portal (P10)

threat_event: Employee personal information in the shared drive is taken in an incident and the 30-day Florida notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR files synced to unencrypted desktops; no incident plan before 2026-08
existing_controls: HR folder restricted to the Owner and Office Manager
treatment_plan: Desktop encryption; P08 notification matrix with the 30-day Florida clock

threat_event: Staff paste FCI, customer test data, or the rewind library into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI rule before 2026-09; Office Manager uses a public chatbot to draft emails
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-04 4.7 approved tools rule; training example

threat_event: A retired or failed office computer is discarded with readable FCI, HR files, or the rewind library
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Desktops unencrypted; no disposal procedure; 2025 retired PC has no record
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: MSP wipe or certified destruction with a record; desktop encryption; ask the MSP what happened to the 2025 PC

threat_event: CIRCIA is finalized as proposed and the shop cannot report a covered cyber incident to CISA within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reporting procedure before 2026-08
existing_controls: P08 runbook includes a voluntary CISA report
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: the rule is proposed only. The Office Manager checks the Federal Register quarterly and updates P08 within 30 days of any final rule

threat_event: A test result on the test PC is altered or mis-entered and a unit ships with an inaccurate test report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared administrator login; no record of who ran or edited a test; report signed from a printout
existing_controls: Shop Manager signs each report after reviewing front-panel readings
treatment_plan: Named test PC accounts with the replacement PC; the Shop Manager compares the report against the test set's stored readings for every federal and cooperative unit

threat_event: An attacker reaches the unsupported test PC through the internet-facing remote desktop port forward and uses it to deploy ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Port-forwarding rule from a 2024 vendor session exposed remote desktop on the test PC; shared administrator password; unsupported operating system; firewall logs kept only 7 days
existing_controls: Rule removed by the MSP on 2026-08-11; offline malware scan of the test PC on 2026-08-12 found nothing
treatment_plan: Change the test PC administrator password; quarterly external port scan by the MSP; no port forwarding without the Owner's written approval; vendor support only through the MSP's attended session tool
